scientific_integrity: Proof uses Fourier/Fejer approximation and an exact odd-coefficient divisibility argument. Finite-grid enumeration is corroborative only; no independent scientific audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Only seven consecutive signs and the balanced half-circle partition; no eight-block sharpness or arbitrary septuple claim. First-public date is day-verified from the motivating 2015 arXiv v1; the older 1951 Anzai article is month-dated in the inspected archive.
title: Seven-block Bernoulli statistics in a zero-entropy cubic toral skew system
